expected.reason: Line 212: `latestVersion.id != (idVersion?.id ?? link?.installedVersionId)` -- when this pass had no fresh hash-identify hit (idVersion nil, item resolved via a persisted-hash/filename fallback), the comparison falls back to the PERSISTED installedVersionId rather than treating the item as having no known current version. This is what lets a manually-linked add-on Modrinth doesn't independently confirm still get a real up-to-date/available verdict instead of a false noCompatibleVersion.
